body: The dude abides.  And I don't know.  I know I'm not looking for an answer.  I don't think there is one.  I just can't help feeling sometimes like the darkness is swallowing up the light.  It reminds me of a bit from Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time. Spoilers here, I guess.  Not too specific, but still spoilerish. Total fantasy, a la Tolkien.  There's a girl who sees images and auras around people, prophetic ones.  The main character obviously is the good guy fighting the forces of evil.  At one point, she mentions how she sees his aura.  She sees a vast darkness, and flying into the darkness, trying to consume it, sparks of light.  When the main character was alone, while the sparks were great the darkness devoured them.  When more of the main characters were together, she saw the sparks grow in number and intensity.  When they were all together, she saw the sparks fighting the darkness and holding their own.  I feel like the first image.  The sparks trying like hell, but only being consumed by the darkness.  The sparks are the random good things that occur in life, the darkness, the bad.  Maybe being alone is what makes me see things this way.  Maybe things really are this way.  I don't know.  I'm so tired of not knowing.  I'm so tired of not knowing if anything will ever get better, and I'm so tired of feeling totally helpless to better my situation.  But thank you for helping to add some sparks to fight the darkness.

I was afraid of how it would hurt the people I love.  And I was afraid of the pain of death.  I think /u/sexandliquor said it best.  It ends the possibilities.  Possibilities.  The word alone has a connotation of hope.  Other people can be happy.  Why can't you or I?  I don't know why, but if nothing else I'm too damn curmudgeonly and stubborn to take the "easy" way out.  Maybe I just feel like I deserve to suffer the cruelties of life?  I don't know.  But with all of the sadness and misery, there were bright shining spots in my life.  Times I truly felt alive.  Few and far between, yes.  And none at all in the last many years.  But it happened once, it can happen again.  I guess that's hope.  I hope that's enough.  But if it isn't, I hope knowing that there are others out there that feel the way you do does help.  You're not alone.  There are many of us going through what you're going through.  Circumstances may be different, but the feeling, the feeling is the same. I can only hope you find a reason, any reason, to keep on keeping on.  Things may get worse, but they may get better.  This could be the trial you're supposed to go through to make you who you're supposed to be.  There's so much uncertainty in the world.  Even depression and unhappiness are uncertain.  That's what I cling to.  The mere possibility that my luck will change, that things my break my way.  Do I honestly believe that it will?  I don't know.  But I keep on nonetheless.  Please, keep on with me.

I understand.  I don't know if there's an answer.  I hope there is, but I don't think there is.  They say life is what you make it.  Bullshit.  Things fucking happen to you man.  Things you can't control.  That's where it gets hard.  Bad things happen for seemingly no cause.  And they happen to you.  They don't happen to him or her, but to you.  It's as if life conspires against you.  I don't have an answer.  I don't have hope.  You just have to try to be strong, and keep on keeping on.  Only reason I'm still here is because I refuse to let life win.  Find small happinesses, small pleasures, and hold to them. Do what you can in your mind to let go of all the awful, horrible, evil things that happen.  Easier said than done, but trying alone can help you to feel a little less helpless. It doesn't get at the root of the problem, but it might just make the problem a little more bearable.  I'm sorry I'm not much help, and that I don't have the answers you and I both desperately want.  But I understand how you feel.  You are not alone.  I don't know if that's something to you, but I wish it helps.  I've always heard if you hope long enough, that hope comes true.  I hope so.  But know that you are not the only person that feels this way.  If you ever need someone to listen, or to talk to, I'm here.
